## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need to document the `openExternalLinkInNewTab` configuration setting in Volto. Currently, this setting, which controls whether external links open in a new tab, is missing from the official documentation.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to add a description of the `openExternalLinkInNewTab` setting to the documentation. The setting defaults to `false`, meaning external links do not open in a new tab unless specified otherwise.

## Helpful background
Understanding how external links function in web applications is essential. The `openExternalLinkInNewTab` setting relates to user experience—deciding whether users stay on the current page while accessing external content. The absence of documentation makes it unclear for users who want to configure this option.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing Pull Request [#4379](https://github.com/plone/volto/pull/4379/files) for context and code details.
2. Check the current documentation at [settings-reference.md](https://github.com/plone/volto/blob/main/docs/source/configuration/settings-reference.md) to see how configurations are formatted.
3. Draft a clear description of the `openExternalLinkInNewTab` setting, including examples if possible.
4. Submit your documentation changes for review through a Pull Request. 

Feel free to ask questions if anything is unclear!
